key_highlights: David Jones enters voluntary administration, precipitating severe insolvency risks across suppliers and mall REIT anchors ahead of Christmas.
ASX 200 (^AXJO) ended the week net higher despite intraday dips, supported by resilient resource and gold equity capital raisings.
Australian housing market faces escalating crash forecasts as borrowing capacity cuts and mortgage pressures bite.
Qantas flags a $1 billion surge in fuel expenses, triggering planned airfare increases and flight capacity reductions.
RBA maintains hawkish bias, indicating unemployment must rise to tame persistent inflation amid stagnant economic growth.

sectors.trend: Collapse of 188-year-old department store David Jones into administration leaves major suppliers unpaid and thousands of jobs at risk.
sectors.implications: Severe inventory liquidation discounting will compress margins across retail peers; direct credit contagion for domestic retail suppliers.

sectors.trend: Mall landlords face anchor vacancy risks while housing market forecasts deteriorate rapidly under diminished household borrowing capacity.
sectors.implications: Retail REIT asset revaluations loom; major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX) face slowing loan book growth and higher mortgage default provisions.

sectors.trend: Strong equity capital raising pipeline in gold and critical minerals exploration, with notable small-cap momentum despite mine safety scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Gold producers provide defensive earnings support and cash generation against geopolitical and macro instability.

sectors.trend: Surging jet fuel costs impose a $1 billion headwind on aviation, while taxpayer scrutiny mounts on major green infrastructure initiatives.
sectors.implications: Aviation margins face severe compression, forcing consumer fare inflation; domestic battery storage emerges as a policy-favoured growth pocket.

sectors.trend: Data centre operators maintain high market interest but confront localised political, power grid, and zoning hurdles.
sectors.implications: High infrastructure valuations for operators like NEXTDC remain intact, though project delivery timelines may stretch.

key_themes: Retail insolvency shock and consumer retrenchment triggered by David Jones collapse
Macroeconomic stagnation and property downturn under restrictive RBA financial conditions
Energy cost headwinds pressuring transport and industrial profit margins
Institutional capital rotation toward precious metals and gold equity raisings

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Retail Supply Chain Contagion & Unpaid Debts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid exposed consumer discretionary suppliers and retail concession holders; favour non-discretionary consumer staples.
Underweight high-LVR mortgage-exposed banks; seek shelter in diversified corporate lenders and liquid defensive assets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Aviation Fuel Cost Inflation & Margin Compression
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce transport beta; rotate into upstream energy producers with natural hedging against oil price spikes.
Prioritise companies with low balance sheet leverage, positive net cash, and strong pricing power.

opportunities.rationale: Strong institutional appetite for gold raisings provides balance sheet strength amidst macro instability and safe-haven demand.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate Digital Infrastructure and Data Centre Leaders on Pullbacks
opportunities.rationale: Secular AI compute demand outweighs localised planning bottlenecks, securing long-term hyperscale tenant demand.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective Exposure to Government-Supported Home Battery & Energy Transition Plays
opportunities.rationale: Subsidised energy storage solutions retain resilient public funding and consumer uptake despite broader budget cutbacks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Retail REITs with High Department Store Exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones store closures will trigger co-tenancy clauses, vacancy spikes, and downward pressure on mall leasing spreads.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Holdings in Domestic Airline and Travel Discretionary Stocks
defensive_moves.rationale: A $1 billion fuel headwind and softening household budgets jeopardise Qantas passenger yields and earnings growth.
Rising unemployment expectations and declining house prices heighten credit risk and slow net interest income expansion.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) will remain volatile and rangebound as retail insolvency fallout and fuel cost burdens counter resources resilience.
market_outlook.long_term: A 6–12 month economic slowdown driven by RBA restrictive policy favours robust balance sheets, gold equities, and critical energy infrastructure over consumer-facing sectors.
key_catalysts: David Jones administration restructuring and creditor recovery outcomes
RBA monetary policy statements and labour market unemployment data
Global crude oil benchmark movements and airline fuel surcharge adjustments
Australian housing market auction clearance rates and monthly price indices
US post-midterm legislative directions and geopolitical developments in the Middle East
watch_list: CoreLogic capital city residential property index
RBA official cash rate expectations and 3-year Australian Commonwealth Government bond yields
AUD/USD exchange rate and commodity prices (iron ore, gold, thermal coal)
Singapore jet fuel crack spread and Brent crude spot prices
ASX consumer discretionary vs staples relative performance index
